GitHub - Jsewill/morton: A Morton Order (Z-Order Curve) library ...
A Go library designed to implement N-dimensional coordinate encoding/decoding to/from Morton Order (Z-Order Curve). What makes this library unique is its dynamic nature. Currently, it supports 2, 3, and 4 dimensions. The ultimate goal is for this library to support as many dimensions can fit within the type width (more on this later).
